description: This file exports specific functions related to runtime configuration and session management from the openclaw/plugin-sdk.

methods.name: evaluateSessionFreshness
methods.description: Evaluates whether a session is fresh based on current context.

methods.name: recordSessionMetaFromInbound
methods.description: Records session metadata from inbound messages.

methods.name: resolveChannelContextVisibilityMode
methods.description: Resolves the visibility mode for a channel context.

methods.name: resolveChannelGroupPolicy
methods.description: Resolves policy settings for a channel group.

methods.name: resolveChannelGroupRequireMention
methods.description: Resolves whether mention is required for a channel group.

methods.name: resolveGroupSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the session key for a group.

methods.name: resolveSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the key used to identify a session.

methods.name: resolveSessionResetPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the reset policy for sessions.

methods.name: resolveSessionResetType
methods.description: Resolves the reset type for sessions.

methods.name: resolveStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the storage path for session data.
